## ScannerSubscriptionRequest

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| `reqId` | `int32` | Unique request identifier used for tracking across EWrapper |
| `scannerSubscription` | `ScannerSubscription` | A scanner subscription objection containing all details required to request scanner data. |
